bio.text: Charles Booker is the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Kentucky in the November 3, 2026 election, having won the May 19 primary.
He represented District 43 in the Kentucky House of Representatives from 2019 to 2020.
He earned a B.S. in political science (2007) and a J.D. (2010) from the University of Louisville.
He was the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in 2022.

sources.title: Charles Booker wins Kentucky Democratic Senate Primary, setting up general election clash with Andy Barr
